name: card-db-mvp
description: CardIndex: the trading-card price guide for buyers and collectors — variant-aware catalog with live market prices, price history and sold comps, photo identification, and a private collection + wishlist. Seeded from the Pokemon TCG API and Scryfall; Postgres + object-storage bucket in production.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T db psql -U cardindex -d cardindex -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /db/schema.postgres.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U cardindex -d cardindex
